# EY DefectIQ


EY DefectIQ uses Pega GenAI to find likely root causes in Azure Devops defect history and surface recommendations with supporting evidence directly on the new issues.

### Overview


EY DefectIQ automates the time-consuming work of finding a likely root cause for a new Azure DevOps defect. Teams often have to search old issues, read long comment threads, and reconstruct investigations that have already been done. EY DefectIQ uses Pega GenAI to compare the new defect’s symptoms, triggers, and affected features with relevant historical issues and, when needed, review their investigation comments for evidence. When the evidence supports a likely cause, EY DefectIQ adds the recommendation, match confidence, a link to the supporting issue, and an explanation directly to the Azure DevOps work item. Teams can start with the evidence, validate the likely cause, and focus on resolving the defect.


### Key Features


- Pega GenAI powered defect matching
- Historical Comment Analysis
- Evidence backed root cause recommendations
- Automated Azure Devops updates.
